SELECT sku, price_inr, cost_inr, (price_inr - cost_inr) as margin_per_unit
FROM store.products;

SELECT 
    SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as total_cogs_june,
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) as total_revenue_june,
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) - SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as gross_profit_june
FROM store.daily_sales ds
JOIN store.products p ON ds.sku = p.sku
WHERE ds.date >= '2026-06-01' AND ds.date <= '2026-06-30';

    SUM(wo.quantity * p.cost_inr) as write_off_cost_june
FROM store.write_offs wo
JOIN store.products p ON wo.sku = p.sku
WHERE wo.date >= '2026-06-01' AND wo.date <= '2026-06-30';

WITH forecast_actual AS (
  SELECT 
    f.date,
    f.forecast_units_per_day,
    COALESCE(d.units_sold, 0) as actual_units
  FROM store.forecasts f
  LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales d 
    ON f.sku = d.sku AND f.date = d.date
  WHERE f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' 
    AND f.date >= '2026-06-01' 
    AND f.date <= '2026-06-28'
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as days,
  ROUND(AVG(forecast_units_per_day)::numeric, 2) as avg_forecast,
  ROUND(AVG(actual_units)::numeric, 2) as avg_actual,
  ROUND(AVG(ABS(forecast_units_per_day - actual_units))::numeric, 2) as mae,
  ROUND(AVG(ABS(forecast_units_per_day - actual_units) / NULLIF(actual_units, 0)) * 100, 2) as mape_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(forecast_units_per_day - actual_units)::numeric, 2) as bias,
  ROUND(SUM(forecast_units_per_day)::numeric, 2) as total_forecast,
  ROUND(SUM(actual_units)::numeric, 2) as total_actual
FROM forecast_actual;

sql_calls.sql:
SELECT bill_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku_scanned) as items_count
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_id LIKE 'B2606%'
GROUP BY bill_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sku_scanned) > 1
ORDER BY items_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH bill_items AS (
  SELECT bill_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_atta,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sku_scanned = 'OIL-SUN-1L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_oil,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sku_scanned = 'DAL-TOOR-1KG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_dal
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_id LIKE 'B2606%'
  GROUP BY bill_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_bills,
  SUM(has_atta) as bills_with_atta,
  SUM(has_oil) as bills_with_oil,
  SUM(has_dal) as bills_with_dal,
  SUM(has_atta * has_oil * has_dal) as bills_with_all_three,
  SUM(has_atta * has_oil) as bills_atta_oil,
  SUM(has_atta * has_dal) as bills_atta_dal,
  SUM(has_oil * has_dal) as bills_oil_dal
FROM bill_items;
